newsitem.title: USA: West Texas shuts 666 MW coal power plant.
newsitem.headline: West Texas shuts 666 MW coal power plant.

text.p: West Texas Utilities Co shut the 666 megawatt Oklaunion coal-fired generating station on Saturday for a three-week seasonal maintenance program, said company spokeswoman Linda Caton said.
The routine work is scheduled every 18 months, she said.
"We have more than enough generation at this time of the year," she added.
The Oklaunion plant, over 100 miles north of Abilene, Tx., is operated by West Texas Utilities, which also holds 54.6 percent stake in the facility.
West Texas Utilities is a subsidiary of Central & South West Corp.
